content.text: Create a document for extended terms and conditions of the card, create a website for the terms and conditions and host it for free, and the QR code would be sharable for the website The QR, I will add it on the card so that anyone who wants to join the committee or want to go through the terms and condition can view the card backside and check the QR code for the extended terms and condition. The terms and condition would include that there would be a FD fixed deposit for the cardholders of the amount twenty five thousand rupees. And if someone misuses the card or if the person denies to the request of the Golden Point Redeemer then the person has to use it or unlock the FD, and that FD amount can be used by the other people who are using the card. So, for example, it's my turn for using the golden point, and I ask my friends to go to Goa with me from Pune. Then... and if they deny it, if they say no, we cannot travel. Then they have they have to unlock their FD of twenty five thousand, and I can use that amount in any way. And if any person wants to join this golden point card usage, they have to be included in our plan at least three times. Only then they will be considered as an eligible contender for getting included in the golden card, which will be then later decided by the Golden Point committee.

GP COMMITTEE

The Golden Point
Charter

Extended Terms & Conditions of Membership
Moniv Nautiyal · Sahil Malik · Akash Verma
Preamble Definitions Rules Security Deposit Membership Spirit Governance Disclaimer
01
Section One

Preamble

The Golden Point is a single, extraordinary favour extended among the members of this Committee. It exists to formalise trust between friends — a favour significant enough to deserve rules, safeguards, and a name.

This Charter is the extended terms and conditions referenced on the reverse of the physical Golden Point card. It governs how the Point is granted, exercised, protected, and inherited.

This is a private, honour-based agreement between friends. It is not a legal contract, a registered financial instrument, or a bank product, and no clause here should be read as one.
02
Section Two

Definitions

  1. Card / Golden Point — the single-use favour represented physically by the Golden Point card.
  2. Holder / Redeemer — the Member whose turn it is to present, or who presents, the Golden Point.
  3. Member — an individual formally inducted per Section Five.
  4. Committee — the GP Committee, currently Moniv Nautiyal, Sahil Malik, and Akash Verma.
  5. FD (Fixed Deposit) — the ₹25,000 security commitment each Member maintains under Section Four.
03
Section Three

Rules of the Golden Point

Carried forward from the physical card, unchanged:

  1. The Golden Point grants its Holder a single, irrevocable request of their choosing.
  2. A presented request must be fulfilled. No designated Member may deny it, subject to the consequences in Section Four if they do.
  3. The request may be of any type or nature — it is not limited to travel, destination, or category.
  4. The Point is valid only among Members formally listed with the Committee.
  5. Any addition to the Committee itself requires unanimous approval of all current Committee members.
04
Section Four

The Security Deposit

₹25,000
FIXED DEPOSIT PER MEMBER
  1. Every Member maintains a personal Fixed Deposit (FD) of ₹25,000 as a standing security commitment tied to their membership of the Golden Point.
  2. The FD exists to give the "must be fulfilled" rule real weight. It is the cost of saying no.
  3. Trigger conditions — a Member's FD is unlocked (forfeited for the Holder's use) if that Member:
    1. Denies or refuses a validly presented Golden Point request, or
    2. Misuses the Golden Point — for example, by inventing a request in bad faith, or acting outside the spirit of Section Three and this Charter.
  4. Once a Member's FD is unlocked, the Holder who presented the Point may use that ₹25,000 in any way they choose — it is not restricted to the original request.
  5. Restoration is decided by the Committee, by unanimous vote — including whether and how a Member replenishes their FD after it has been unlocked.
ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE

Akash holds the Golden Point and asks the group to travel from Pune to Goa with him. A Member refuses. That Member's FD unlocks, and Akash may use the ₹25,000 however he wishes — including, but not limited to, funding the trip himself.

05
Section Five

Becoming a Member

  1. A prospective Member must first be included in the group's plans or activities on at least three (3) separate occasions.
  2. Meeting this threshold makes a person an eligible contender — it does not itself grant membership.
  3. Eligible contenders are admitted only by unanimous vote of the GP Committee.
  4. Admission adds the new Member's name to the physical card and this Charter.
06
Section Six

Spirit of the Charter

The Golden Point works because it is rarely, and seriously, invoked. Members are expected to act in good faith — both in presenting requests and in honouring them — and to treat the FD mechanism as a safeguard, not a game to be gamed.

07
Section Seven

Governance & Amendments

  1. This Charter may only be amended by unanimous agreement of the GP Committee.
  2. The Committee is the final authority on any dispute arising from the use, denial, or misuse of a Golden Point.
08
Section Eight

Disclaimer

This Charter is an informal, honour-based agreement between friends. The "FD" described here is a private commitment between Members, not a regulated bank deposit, and this document creates no legal or financial obligation enforceable outside the group.

Moniv Nautiyal
Sahil Malik
Akash Verma

Present this Charter alongside the physical Golden Point card.

Issued and amendable only by unanimous vote of the GP Committee.

Excellent, the vignette example reads very well. Let's check the footer.

Both files are ready — a formal Word charter and a full gold-and-black themed website that mirrors the card's look, covering all your rules (the ₹25,000 FD, denial/misuse forfeiture, the Goa example, the 3-times induction rule, unanimous committee approval).

**On hosting it for free** — I can't create accounts or push to hosting services on your behalf, but this takes about 2 minutes with GitHub Pages (free forever, no card needed):

1. Go to github.com → sign in (or sign up free) → **New repository**, name it e.g. `golden-point-charter`.
2. Click **Add file → Upload files**, drag in `golden-point-charter-website.html`, then rename it to `index.html` (GitHub lets you rename right before committing).
3. Go to **Settings → Pages** → under "Source" pick the `main` branch, root folder → **Save**.
4. Wait ~60 seconds — GitHub gives you a live link like `https://<your-username>.github.io/golden-point-charter/`.

That link is what the QR code should point to.

**For the QR itself** — tell me your GitHub username (or just paste the live link once it's up) and I'll generate a high-resolution, print-ready QR code image instantly for you to add to the card's back.
